title: The flamingo head-flag challenge (campers)
storyboard: Film: 8–10 campers in a tight flock, heads flicking left-right in sync to the beat; wide + side, 3 takes
caption:
Our campers tried the original group dance.

In large colonies, thousands of flamingos can display together, lifting and turning their heads at the same moment.

Source: Smithsonian's National Zoo.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
